title: Effects of anti-aging diets and exercise on age-related musculoskeletal diseases via gut microbiota modulation.
snippet: This review summarizes evidence on how anti-aging diets and exercise influence age-related musculoskeletal diseases through modulation of the gut microbiota. title: Meta-analysis of NPC2-mediated cholesterol transport in human cancers as a prognostic biomarker with therapeutic implications.
snippet: NPC2 is a lysosomal cholesterol transporter involved in intracellular lipid trafficking and cholesterol homeostasis, processes that have been increasingly implicated in cancer biology.
